verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack shows a public pricing page with per-volume tiers, overage rates, or add-on costs (dedicated IPs, validation) for SendGrid — all citations are docs/API/community sentiment about deliverability and cost concerns, not pricing structure. Community comments only vaguely mention costs rising above 500k contacts, with no published tier/rate details, and other comments suggest a shift toward enterprise sales rather than self-serve transparent pricing.
